concerns.text: FR-002 requires 'phylogenetic MICE' imputation. Task T014a implements 'standard MICE' (sklearn.impute.IterativeImputer). No task exists to implement the phylogenetic variant or a fallback mechanism explicitly tied to the missing tree constraint in the spec.

Constitution Principle VI mandates 'Imputation of missing continuous trait values via median substitution'. Task T014a implements MICE. No task exists to implement median substitution or reconcile this conflict with the spec's FR-002.

FR-001 requires downloading genomic data from 'NCBI RefSeq'. Task T012 generates 'synthetic genomic features'. No task exists to implement the actual NCBI RefSeq download logic, leaving the spec requirement unimplemented.

SC-005 requires validating top features against '15 independent ABA-signaling genes' from literature. Task T029 validates against a 'synthetic validation list' defined in the task itself. No task exists to source or load the independent literature-based gene list.

FR-009 requires a baseline using a 'phylogenetic distance matrix'. Task T016 generates a 'synthetic phylogenetic distance matrix' with random values. No task exists to implement the retrieval or calculation of a real phylogenetic matrix.
